title: Finland: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first against lung cancer delay
markdown:
# Finland: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first against lung cancer delay

## The gap in one sentence
No measured county indicator is loaded for this national scope, so no measured gap can be stated here. The model estimates 155 days (149–162) from first symptom to treatment start nationally [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The longest step is the patient interval, from first symptom to first primary care contact. The model estimates it at 56 days (52–61) [^model], derived from a reported "over 50 days" with no listed drivers [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20242733]. Primary care contact to referral is a reported point value of 41 days, with no published interval [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20242733].

The one measured step is diagnosis to treatment start, published at national level. The Finnish Cancer Registry median for 1.1.2018–30.6.2022 was 37 days for surgery, 36 for radiotherapy and 38 for drug therapy [^fcr_lung_quality_report_pdf]. For surgery, the collaborative-area medians range from 13.5 days in Northern Finland (OYS) to 46.0 days in Southern Finland (HUS) [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
1. **What:** A symptom awareness campaign in Lapland on the "Be Clear on Cancer" model, telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor [^model]. Lapland has the lowest measured curative-intent treatment share, 18.5% against 27.0% nationally (2019–2023) [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society; county communications and primary care [^model]. **Cost:** EUR 13,931 a year. This is scaled from the roadmap's EUR 400,000 national budget, and repeating it yearly is an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.57 deaths avoided per year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, a national communication plan to raise awareness of cancer symptoms [^roadmap_1.3.2].
2. **What:** The same campaign in Kymenlaakso [^model]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society; county communications and primary care [^model]. **Cost:** EUR 12,510 a year, with yearly repetition an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.48 deaths avoided per year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2 [^roadmap_1.3.2].
3. **What:** The same campaign in South Savo [^model]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society; county communications and primary care [^model]. **Cost:** EUR 10,518 a year, with yearly repetition an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.36 deaths avoided per year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2 [^roadmap_1.3.2].

The full package costs EUR 997,898 [^model]. It is estimated to avoid 16.76 deaths a year (9.53–23.36) [^model].

## What to measure from Monday
- Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county [^model]
- Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county [^model]
- Stage at diagnosis and the curative-intent share, by county [^model]
- Date of first symptom or first primary care contact [^model]

## Limits of this analysis
Most of the step days are estimates, not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. The 155-day total comes from an unpublished four-city Finnish study reported by Yle in 2026 [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979]. A consistency check found that 0 of 3 county outcomes correlate with the estimated clock beyond chance [^model]. The closest was the curative-intent share (rho -0.30, permutation p 0.17) [^model]. This is a check, not a validation, and it is confounded by age, smoking and stage [^model].
